changed.new_text: Delivery rule 6: if 2 of the user's nudges for that local day already have `delivery` `sent`, the nudge becomes `suppressed` with reason `daily_limit`.
changed.old_text: Delivery rule 6: if 3 of the user's nudges for that local day already have `delivery` `sent`, the nudge becomes `suppressed` with reason `daily_limit`.

changed.new_text: So a habit gets at most one push per day and a user at most 2 pushes per local day; every nudge, pushed or not, stays in the in-app list.
changed.old_text: So a habit gets at most one push per day and a user at most 3 pushes per local day; every nudge, pushed or not, stays in the in-app list.

changed.new_text: Clear pushes never count towards the daily limit of 2 pushes in delivery rule 6.
changed.old_text: Clear pushes never count towards the daily limit of 3 pushes in delivery rule 6.

summary.note: Which workflows fail is mostly not decidable before the change exists: a flow records the answers the app gives today, so it passes today by construction. Before an implementation only a changed invariant (tier 1, observed) and an exact-prefix contradiction (tier 2, determined) decide a workflow; every other flow listed is tier 3 'may_fail' (static, with unknowns), settled by tier 4 (Spike E, observed after the change).
